scope: Read-only pre-output screen-contract review; no model construction or inference performed by reviewer.
findings: Pinned model, runtime Python source, source WAV, prepared array and reference file identities are checked before and after recognition.
The unchanged full float32 PCM array is checked at input and at the actual frontend, including full sample count and hash; no VAD, cropping or chunking is introduced.
Recognition supplies only full waveform and sample_rate; source/target language, references, prompts and correction data are not passed.
Native decoder token IDs, frame indices and log probabilities are retained; decoded return is compared exactly with the raw adapter result, with timestamp structure/order/bounds checked.
CPU provider and thread counts are checked on actual sessions. Tokenizer/blank/emissions/timestamp scale are checked against loaded fields.

Offline and telemetry settings are asserted, the Python socket audit hook denies connect/address resolution, and ORT telemetry is disabled before session construction. This is not independent network capture.
One owned worker process group is monitored and terminated on runtime limits; no existing-result overwrite or retry path is used.
Initialization limit now starts from controller launch. Controller deadlines are sampled at 100 ms; final measured per-case/init/total timings and RSS must be reviewed before accepting feasibility.
Completed Small replay and independent review are now comparison sources; the original eight setup errors remain separately labeled historical failure context.
limits_of_review: No semantic quality or correct timestamp alignment can be inferred before actual outputs.
Resource accounting is for the owned worker/process group, with sampled group RSS and recorded worker peak RSS; it is not a whole-machine or unsampled-total-peak guarantee.
The prototype is auto-language recognizer-only. Prior Small/Turbo evidence uses an explicit-language app path, so it is not a matched pipeline benchmark or app integration validation.
decision: No material pre-output blocker found; authorized single screen may proceed. No production adoption approved.
